recipe.name: Anday ka Korma
recipe.summary: I love eating Anday ka Korma. It’s comfort food at its best. My family loves eating this with warm, buttery, fluffy naan. It always makes for a delicious family dinner

steps.text: If the below spices are not roasted, you can heat a dry frying pan and roast the spices and cashews till they are golden brown.
steps.text_plain: If the below spices are not roasted, you can heat a dry frying pan and roast the spices and cashews till they are golden brown.

steps.text: Make a paste with 1/2 cup roasted cashews 2 fried onions 5 tbsp roasted coconut powder 2 tbsp roasted poppy seeds 1/2 cup yogurt.
steps.text_plain: Make a paste with 1/2 cup roasted cashews 2 fried onions 5 tbsp roasted coconut powder 2 tbsp roasted poppy seeds 1/2 cup yogurt.

steps.text: Heat some oil in a pan and add in the boiled eggs and let it get a little light brown.
steps.text_plain: Heat some oil in a pan and add in the boiled eggs and let it get a little light brown.

steps.text: Remove the eggs and set aside.
steps.text_plain: Remove the eggs and set aside.

steps.text: Now add the cinnamon, cardamom shah zeera and cloves.
steps.text_plain: Now add the cinnamon, cardamom shah zeera and cloves.

steps.text: Sauté that for a few minutes Add the ginger and garlic paste and let that cook for a few minutes
steps.text_plain: Sauté that for a few minutes Add the ginger and garlic paste and let that cook for a few minutes

steps.text: Cook really well and keep stirring for about 5-6 minutes Stir in the red chili powder, turmeric, salt.
steps.text_plain: Cook really well and keep stirring for about 5-6 minutes Stir in the red chili powder, turmeric, salt.

steps.text: Mix well and add some water. Keep stirring.
steps.text_plain: Mix well and add some water. Keep stirring.

steps.text: Cook till the oil comes to the top.
steps.text_plain: Cook till the oil comes to the top.

steps.text: Now add the coriander powder and the garam masala.
steps.text_plain: Now add the coriander powder and the garam masala.

steps.text: Keep stirring and add some more water.
steps.text_plain: Keep stirring and add some more water.

steps.text: Cook till the oil comes to the top and then add the cilantro and lemon juice.
steps.text_plain: Cook till the oil comes to the top and then add the cilantro and lemon juice.

steps.text: Add the eggs and stir well.
steps.text_plain: Add the eggs and stir well.

steps.text: Cover and cook on a low flame till the oil comes to the top. Enjoy.
